limitations: Only even positive tuple counts; two-primary common-divisor valuations, not odd prime factors or exact termwise valuations. A broader independently published equivalent remains possible.
scientific_integrity: Formal-power-series proof with an explicitly cited primary two-dissection; finite computations are consistency checks, not the proof. The odd-parameter case is pre-existing and excluded from the novelty claim.
title: Sharp two-witness valuation law for even designated multipartitions
